args.title: Handle trailing empty lines gracefully in statement imports
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser currently throws a 'Malformed row' error when a statement file ends with a blank line. This change should include an update to gracefully skip lines that are empty after splitting, thus preventing the erroneous 'Malformed row' error.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'Malformed row' error occurs because the parser mishandles files ending with an empty line. The change suggests modifying the parser function to skip over these empty lines gracefully.
